label: Bible Study
prompt: Beloved, if God so loved us, we _____ also to love one another.
verse: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
note: If God loved like that, John says, the obligation is obvious.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And they shall see his _____; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
verse: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
note: Maybe the best line in heaven's description: they shall see His face.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white _____; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
verse: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
note: Heaven opens and a white horse appears, its rider called Faithful and True.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a _____ beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
verse: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
note: Paul sends Onesimus back to his master Philemon — not as a mere slave now, but as a beloved brother.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him _____ that taketh his name in vain.
verse: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
note: The third commandment carries a warning label: the LORD will not hold him 'guiltless' who takes his name in vain.
